title: Programmable Bench Power Supply
description: A high-precision DC power supply with digital control via encoder and OLED display, featuring low-noise linear regulation.
materials:
• Output Range: 0-30V / 0-5A
• Control: Digital encoder interface with OLED feedback
• Regulation: Low-noise linear regulation with < 1mV RMS ripple
• Safety: Over-current and short-circuit protection implemented in hardware
results: The biggest engineering challenge was thermal management. This was solved by implementing a smart ventilation control system that modulates fan speed based on heatsink temperature sensor data.
